headline: North Korea Suspends Military Aid to Russia Amid Diplomatic Dispute
summary: North Korea temporarily suspended military assistance to Russia following a diplomatic dispute over Moscow’s efforts to ease tensions between Pyongyang and Seoul, Ukraine’s military intelligence reported.

impacts.name: North Korea
impacts.why: Suspending cross-border military supply agreements alters geopolitical defense cooperation dynamics.
